record.question: The components of Central assistance in the form of grants and remaining interest free loan with rationalisation of public expenditure under the Special Category Status are
record.explanation: Answer C: 90:10. 90:10 is the historical grant-to-loan pattern for central assistance to Special Category States. The 2014–15 Union Budget notes explicitly specify 90% grant and 10% loan. The question's additional claim that the loan is interest-free is not established by that budget provision and must not be repeated as a verified feature. Historical/source note: Historical grant:loan ratio 90:10; the source's interest-free characterization is not supported by the cited provision, and arrangements differ by scheme and period. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/budget2014-2015%28I%29/ub2014-15/eb/allsbe.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
